methodological_correction.reason: The historical transmission chain is observed retrospectively; transmission conditions were not experimentally controlled.

core_hypothesis.text: Recognizable cultural forms can remain transmissible even when their original function and semantics are strongly reduced, replaced, or inverted.

layer_retention_score.reason: Different layers can diverge strongly; a single aggregate score can hide the signature of mutation.
layer_retention_score.important_rule: Semantic or affective inversion is not encoded as a negative retention score. Retention magnitude and polarity are recorded separately.

shape.basis: Egyptian visual grammar and recognizable Anubis-like silhouette remain central.

agent_identity.basis: Anubis-like agent remains recognizable; exact source identities are not yet locked.

context.basis: Egyptian setting is simulated, while original funerary ritual context is removed and replaced by a pseudo-historical meme textbook context.

gesture.basis: Canonical ritual pose is replaced by an invented comic gesture.

affect.basis: Sacred/serious mortuary affect is recoded into absurdity and comic irony.

function_semantics.basis: Funerary judgement/protection/transformation semantics are replaced by satire about meme culture and cultural repetition.

validation_design.principle: Test the same retention vector on independent transmission traces before treating FORM_SURVIVES_FUNCTION as a general model.

first_control.why_first: It preserves the same modality as EGY_MEME and therefore minimizes cross-modal confounds.
first_control.question: Can a historically didactic mortality image-family retain recognizable visual form while its social function and affect migrate into modern dark humor, meme, or shitposting contexts?
required_evidence: separate scoring of shape, agent, context, gesture, affect and function
first_control.firewall: Visual resemblance alone does not establish direct lineage; independent historical/transmission evidence is required before calling a modern image a descendant rather than an analogy.

second_control.why_second: This tests whether the retention framework generalizes beyond visual transmission into rhythm/phonology, where semantic retention may collapse while formal cadence survives.
second_control.required_caution: Do not assert ancient-magical-formula ancestry without a documented philological transmission chain. Similar nonsense syllables are insufficient.

pass_conditions.model_local_pass: At least one independent visual case shows high form retention with substantially lower function/semantic retention under a documented or strongly source-bound transmission trace.
pass_conditions.cross_modal_pass: A second modality reproduces the asymmetry using modality-appropriate layers without requiring the same mutation operators.
pass_conditions.fail_condition: Apparent form persistence disappears once direct lineage, chronology, or source identity is checked, leaving only superficial resemblance.
pass_conditions.open_condition: Historical lineage remains ambiguous or modern examples are analogies rather than descendants.

anti_overclaim_firewall: FORM_SURVIVES_FUNCTION is a hypothesis about transmissibility, not a universal law.
High recognizability does not prove causal descent.
Semantic loss is not assumed to increase transmissibility unless independently demonstrated.
A single striking case cannot establish a general cultural-evolution mechanism.
Retention magnitude and affective/semantic inversion must be represented separately.
No archaeological or religious claim may be inferred from modern meme reuse.
canonical_seal: MEASURE WHAT SURVIVES BY LAYER. DO NOT HIDE MUTATION INSIDE ONE SCORE. FORM MAY OUTLIVE FUNCTION, BUT LINEAGE MUST BE SHOWN, NOT ASSUMED.
